extensionDescription.message: Enhance your Thunderbird inbox with automated profile images, adding company logos or avatars to emails and contacts while supporting BIMI

contactsIntegrationLabel.message: Auto add profile picture when saving a contact
contactsIntegrationLabel.description: Label for the contacts integration checkbox.

inboxListLabel.description: Label for the inbox list checkbox.

inboxListDescription.message: Shows a picture next to each message in the list.
inboxListDescription.description: Description of the inbox list feature.

inboxListExperimentalNote.message: This feature reaches into parts of Thunderbird that can change between releases. If the message list misbehaves, turn it off and report the problem.
inboxListExperimentalNote.description: Warning message for the inbox list feature.

cacheSizeLabel.description: Label for the cache size display.

clearCacheButton.description: Label for the clear cache button.

cacheCleared.description: Message displayed when the cache is cleared.

profilePictureNotFound.description: Message displayed when the profile picture is not found.

errorDisplayingImage.message: Error displaying image (see console for details)
errorDisplayingImage.description: Error message displayed when there's an error displaying the image.

emailInputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the email input field.

noIcons.description: Count displayed when no icons are stored in cache.

oneIcon.description: Count displayed when 1 icon is stored in cache.

multipleIcons.description: Count displayed when multiple icons are stored in cache.

providersHeader.description: Header for the picture sources section.

providersDescription.message: Sources are tried from top to bottom, and the first picture found is used. Turning off sources you don't need makes lookups faster.
providersDescription.description: Explanation of how the provider chain works.

providerIconHorse.description: Name of the Icon Horse provider.

providerFaviconWebpage.description: Name of the favicon scraping provider.

providerBadgeThirdParty.description: Badge marking a provider that discloses the correspondent to an outside service.

providerBadgeSlow.description: Badge marking a provider whose lookups are expensive.

privacyModeLabel.description: Label for the privacy mode selector.

privacyModeBalanced.message: Only the sender's own DNS records

privacyModeOffHint.message: Every source you enable below may be contacted. Outside services will learn the domains, and in some cases the addresses, of people who write to you.

privacyModeBalancedHint.message: Only BIMI is used: a DNS lookup against the sender's own domain. No outside service is contacted, and no request is made to the sender's website. Fewer pictures will be found.

privacyModeStrictHint.message: No pictures are looked up online. Only address book photos, pictures already cached, and generated initials are shown.

providerBadgeBlocked.description: Badge marking a source disabled by the current privacy mode.

settingsIntro.message: Show a picture for the people who write to you, taken from their address book entry or their organisation's logo.

testDescription.message: See which picture an address resolves to with your current settings.

cacheRefreshFoundLabel.message: Look up a saved picture again after

cacheRefreshFoundHelp.message: Picks up logo changes and newly published BIMI records. Longer means fewer lookups.

cacheRefreshNotFoundLabel.message: Retry addresses with no picture after

cacheRefreshNotFoundHelp.message: Most addresses that have no picture never get one, so retrying often costs requests without finding anything.

initialsColorHelp.message: Initials are shown when no picture is found. A colour per sender makes them easier to tell apart; one grey keeps a long list calmer.
